auditMetadata.auditorRole: Independent ERP, Financial Controls, Security & Integrity Auditor
auditMetadata.scope: Full Product Audit (Backend, Frontend, Portals, Invariants, Security, Accounting)

findings.title: Public Unauthenticated CRUD Access to Audit Trail
findings.expectedBehavior: Audit logs must require Admin authentication and must be immutable (append-only) to guarantee regulatory and compliance integrity.
findings.actualBehavior: AuditController has zero authentication guards. Unauthenticated callers can read (GET /audit), update (PATCH /audit/:id), delete (DELETE /audit/:id), or inject (POST /audit) audit logs.
findings.businessImpact: Attackers or malicious insiders can erase or tamper with operational and financial audit logs without detection.
findings.remediation: Add @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'), RolesGuard) and @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN). Remove PATCH and DELETE endpoints to ensure append-only immutability.

findings.title: Public Unauthenticated Branch CRUD Operations
findings.expectedBehavior: Branch creation and modification should be restricted to authenticated Admin users.
findings.actualBehavior: BranchController lacks all authentication guards, allowing anonymous callers to create, modify, or delete company branches.
findings.businessImpact: Unauthorized branch creation, modification, or deletion.
findings.remediation: Protect BranchController with JwtAuthGuard and RolesGuard restricted to ADMIN.

findings.title: Cross-Distributor Global Customer Data & PII Exposure
findings.expectedBehavior: Distributors and delivery partners should access only customers whose orders are assigned to their territory or agency.
findings.actualBehavior: GET /customer is decorated with @Roles(UserRole.DISTRIBUTOR, UserRole.DELIVERY_PARTNER), and customerService.findAll() returns every customer record with full names, phone numbers, addresses, wallet balances, and schedules.
findings.businessImpact: Severe multi-tenant privacy breach and competitor data leakage across competing distributors.
findings.remediation: Remove DISTRIBUTOR and DELIVERY_PARTNER roles from global findAll(). Implement a scoped endpoint returning only customers assigned to the requesting partner.

findings.title: Delivery Partners Can Mutate Customer PII and Arbitrarily Override Jar Counts
findings.expectedBehavior: Delivery partners should have read-only access to delivery addresses and contact information. Jars at customer should only change through validated order delivery receipts.
findings.actualBehavior: PATCH /customer/:id allows DELIVERY_PARTNER to modify customer details and update jarsAtCustomer to any arbitrary integer without audit trail or inventory logs.
findings.businessImpact: Drivers can falsify customer phone numbers or alter customer-held jar quantities to mask losses or thefts.
findings.remediation: Revoke DELIVERY_PARTNER from customer update endpoint. Remove jarsAtCustomer from UpdateCustomerDto.

findings.title: Infinite Zero-Cost Subscription Orders Generated Without Jar Balance Deduction
findings.expectedBehavior: Subscription orders should deduct from prepaid customer jar balance or wallet. If balance is zero, order creation must be blocked or marked as unpaid.
findings.actualBehavior: SubscriptionScheduler generates daily orders with totalAmount: 0 and paymentStatus: SUCCESS without calling BalanceEngine or validating customer jar balance.
findings.businessImpact: Direct financial leakage: customers can create recurring rules and receive free water deliveries indefinitely.
findings.remediation: Integrate BalanceEngine.deductJars() inside the subscription scheduler transaction; reject or mark pending if customer lacks balance.

findings.title: Supplier Balance Calculation Freezes on Manual Adjustment
findings.expectedBehavior: Supplier balance must be the cumulative sum of opening balance + all purchase debits - all payment credits up to the current date.
findings.actualBehavior: SupplierService.findAll() checks for latest adjustment transaction and returns its balance directly, ignoring any purchases or payments recorded after the adjustment.
findings.businessImpact: Distributor financial reports show inaccurate accounts payable balances to suppliers.
findings.remediation: Compute supplier balances across all transaction rows or maintain a continuous running balance ledger.

findings.title: Prepaid Short Delivery Amounts Are Not Automatically Refunded to Customer Wallet
findings.expectedBehavior: When a customer prepays online for N items but receives fewer items, the excess prepaid amount should be automatically credited to customer wallet.
findings.actualBehavior: Delivery settlement calculates the reduced total but leaves excess paid amounts attached to the order without wallet credit or refund trigger.
findings.businessImpact: Customer financial discrepancy and manual refund overhead.
findings.remediation: Trigger wallet credit (WalletTransactionType.REFUND) during delivery completion when paidAmount > calculatedTotal.

findings.title: Overlapping Unlinked Customer Jar Balance Models
findings.expectedBehavior: Customer jar holdings should be tracked by a single authoritative ledger linked to physical yard dispatches and returns.
findings.actualBehavior: Four disparate models track jars: Customer.jarsAtCustomer, JarBalance, JarOwnership, and JarInventoryItem. Order delivery updates Customer and JarInventoryItem, but not JarBalance or JarOwnership.
findings.businessImpact: Customer portal displays divergent jar counts from distributor yard records.
findings.remediation: Establish a single authoritative jar ledger service that synchronizes physical custody with customer ownership.

findings.title: Purchases Do Not Receive Physical Stock into Inventory
findings.expectedBehavior: Completing a purchase for materials or jars should automatically increment distributor or warehouse physical stock.
findings.actualBehavior: PurchaseService.create() records purchase financial items as JSON but never updates RawMaterialItem, DistributorRawMaterialStock, or JarInventoryItem.
findings.businessImpact: Purchasing is disconnected from inventory operations; stock must be manually adjusted.
findings.remediation: Add an inventory receiving workflow triggered on purchase bill confirmation.

findings.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) on Order Details
findings.expectedBehavior: A customer requesting GET /order/:id should receive a 403 Forbidden if the order does not belong to them.
findings.actualBehavior: orderService.findOne() only masks the OTP if the user is not the owner, but returns full customer name, phone number, address, and items.
findings.businessImpact: Any customer can inspect another customer's order history and delivery address by guessing or incrementing IDs.
findings.remediation: Add ownership check throwing ForbiddenException for customer roles.

findings.title: System Settings Readable by All Authenticated Users
findings.expectedBehavior: Internal system settings should be restricted to Admin and Manager roles.
findings.actualBehavior: GET /settings is guarded only by JwtAuthGuard without role restrictions.
findings.businessImpact: Leads to internal configuration exposure to customers and drivers.

findings.title: Missing Rate Limiting on Authentication and OTP Endpoints
findings.expectedBehavior: Auth endpoints and OTP verification should be protected by rate limiters.
findings.actualBehavior: No ThrottlerModule or rate-limiting middleware is configured in the NestJS application.
findings.businessImpact: Susceptibility to brute-force credential stuffing and OTP enumeration.
findings.remediation: Configure @nestjs/throttler globally with tight limits on /auth/* and /profile/*-otp.

findings.title: Distributor Wallet Route Renders Placeholder
findings.expectedBehavior: Distributor should have an operational wallet and settlement view.
findings.actualBehavior: Route /distributor/wallet renders OperationalPlaceholder stating 'Operational controls for wallet will be attached here.'
findings.businessImpact: Distributors cannot review financial settlements or ledger balances inside their portal.
findings.remediation: Implement the Distributor Wallet page with live jar settlement and purchase ledger data.

findings.title: Admin Finance Ledger Component Disconnected and Unrouted
findings.expectedBehavior: Admin portal should provide a finance dashboard displaying recharge wallets, deposits, and settlements.
findings.actualBehavior: FinanceLedger.tsx exists with placeholder text but is never imported or routed in AdminPortal.tsx.
findings.businessImpact: Administrators lack a central UI to inspect customer deposit balances and wallet liability.
findings.remediation: Route FinanceLedger.tsx in AdminPortal and connect it to live transaction tables.

findings.title: 8 Backend Unit Test Suites Failing Due to Outdated Test Stubs
findings.expectedBehavior: npm test in backend should pass with 100% green tests.
findings.actualBehavior: 30 suites pass (220 tests), 8 suites fail (7 tests) due to missing service dependencies in test builders.
findings.businessImpact: CI/CD failure and regression blind spots.
findings.remediation: Update test module providers to supply RawMaterialService and PrismaService mocks.
